single.rationale: ADI shows recovery with 17% revenue growth in FY2025 after a challenging FY2024, driven by broad-based demand and inventory normalization, particularly in Industrial (test equipment, aerospace/defense) and AI-driven data center infrastructure. However, significant headwinds include cyclical semiconductor risks, substantial China exposure amid escalating export restrictions, heightened tariff uncertainty, elevated valuation (50x P/E), and margins still below FY2023 peaks despite improvement.
